issues: The importLedger acceptance test fails because initLedgerIfNeeded does not create "imported" ledger entries. The ledger entries are not being persisted or retrieved correctly: after adding receipts and mileage before initializing the ledger, verifyLedger reports zero entries of kind "imported". This stems from the ledger implementation using the Store's get/set methods which encrypt/decrypt data, but the ledger is stored under the key "ledger" without handling its encryption correctly during init, causing the entries to be lost or not saved. Fix the ledger core by ensuring that initLedgerIfNeeded correctly writes imported entries to the encrypted store (using addLedgerEntry which already persists to the store) and that addLedgerEntry itself correctly computes and saves the hash chain. Also remove the redundant LEDGER_KEY constant in receiptStore (use the Ledger functions consistently) and ensure that receiptStore and mileageStore always call addLedgerEntry for creation (including during import) without conditional checks that skip ledger entry creation when the ledger is empty. After these corrections, the importLedger test should see two imported entries and all other ledger-related tests should pass.

feedback": "Fix ledger initialization and entry persistence so that imported records are correctly recorded. Ensure addLedgerEntry works with the encrypted Store and that initLedgerIfNeeded creates the entries. Also adjust receiptStore's conditional ledger entry creation to always log creations (the import phase will be handled by initLedgerIfNeeded). Once these changes are made, re-run tests to confirm all acceptance tests pass.
